source: Motto of the Bahishkrit Hitakarini Sabha, 1924

text: Caste is not a division of labour. It is a division of labourers.
I measure the progress of a community by the degree of progress which women have achieved.
Political democracy cannot last unless there lies at the base of it social democracy.
However good a Constitution may be, if those who are implementing it are not good, it will prove to be bad.
Lost rights are never regained by begging... but by relentless struggle.
The Buddha's method was to change the mind of man.
I prefer Buddhism because it gives three principles in combination: prajna, karuna and samata.
Though I was born a Hindu, I will not die a Hindu.
Men are mortal. So are ideas. An idea needs propagation as much as a plant needs watering.
